title: Hot Smoked Norwegian Sea Bass Skewers
description: A peppery and tender Norwegian dish featuring sea bass fillets, perfect for a sick day, this recipe is sugar-free friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 225 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, black pepper, salt, lemon juice, olive oil, and garlic powder.
Add the sea bass pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated sea bass pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the smoker, close the lid, and smoke for 30 minutes.
Add the wood chips to the smoker and continue to smoke for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the smoker and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the hot smoked sea bass skewers immediately, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
